% Reproduction fixture for BUG-20:
% build_minimal_preamble does not capture \newtheoremrm declarations
% (class-specific theorem-environment definers beyond \newtheorem).
%
% Observed in 2501.09243 which uses tac.cls:
%   \newtheoremrm{rem}{Remark} defines the {rem} environment.
%   build_minimal_preamble only captures \newtheorem, not \newtheoremrm.
%   Pipeline output fails with: ! LaTeX Error: Environment rem undefined.
%
% This minimal fixture uses the standard article class which doesn't have
% \newtheoremrm, so we simulate the pattern with a custom class command
% to demonstrate what should be preserved.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
% \newtheoremrm is a tac.cls-specific variant of \newtheorem.
% For this fixture, we demonstrate the analogous problem:
% any unknown \newXXXtheorem-style command in the preamble is stripped.
% The fix: _NEWTHEOREM_RE should also match \newtheoremrm{...}{...}
\newtheorem{rem}{Remark}
\begin{document}
\begin{rem}
This is a remark.
\end{rem}
\end{document}
